text: The Campus Housing Advisory Committee is a Standing Committee of The University of Texas at Dallas appointed by the President. The Committee is charged to advise the Associate Vice President for Student Affairs on policies, procedures, and rules which will optimize the overall operation of university-owned housing. The scope of the Committee's purview shall include such areas as financial and physical operations and facilities, student services and programs, and all other matters related to university-owned housing that the Committee shall deem it appropriate to consider, including matters referred to it by the University Housing Administration, Graduate Student Assembly (GSA) and/or Student Government (SG). In addition, the Committee shall make recommendations regarding the interests and concerns of the residents of university-owned housing. The Committee shall meet at least once each month during the long semester and shall set dates for its meetings and formulate its own rules of procedure.
source_title: UTD Policy UTDPP1009: Campus Housing Advisory Committee

text: The Campus Housing Advisory Committee membership shall consist of fifteen (15) voting members living in university-owned housing. They shall include students from each of the following areas to be appointed by the President of the University, or the President's designee, from a panel submitted by the designated units: (a) one (1) student living in university-owned housing who is currently serving on SG nominated by the Student Government Executive Committee, with preference given to the Residential Student Affairs Chairman or a Residential Student Affairs Committee Member who resides on campus; (b) one (1) graduate student living in university-owned housing and who is nominated by the GSA; (c) two (2) peer advisers, one living in the residence halls and one living in the apartments, nominated by the Director of Residential Life; (d) three (3) students living in university-owned housing and in the Residential Housing Association (RHA), National Residence Hall Honorary (NRHH), and the Living Learning Communities student leadership nominated by the Director of Residential Life; (e) five (5) freshman students living in university-owned residence hall housing chosen by application to sit on the committee; and (f) three (3) students living in university-owned apartment housing chosen by application to sit on the committee.
source_title: UTD Policy UTDPP1009: Campus Housing Advisory Committee

text: The President or Vice President of the Student Government, Graduate Student Assembly President or Vice President, Director of Residential Life, Senior Director of Housing Operations, Dean of Undergraduate Education or designee, Dean of Graduate Studies or designee, Vice President for Budget and Finance or designee, Assistant Vice President for Residential Life and the Associate Vice President for Student Affairs serve as non-voting ex-officio members of the Campus Housing Advisory Committee. The term of office will be for one (1) year, and members will serve from October 1 to September 30. Members may be reappointed by the President, or the President's designee, for additional terms. Should a vacancy arise at any time on the Committee, it shall be filled according to the appropriate membership procedures outlined in this policy.
source_title: UTD Policy UTDPP1009: Campus Housing Advisory Committee
section_heading: Membership: Ex-Officio Members, Terms, and Vacancies

text: The Associate Vice President for Student Affairs or designee shall convene the first meeting of the Campus Housing Advisory Committee each fall term for the purpose of selecting the Chair and Vice Chair, who will be elected by the voting members. A recording secretary shall be provided by University Housing. The recording secretary's main duty shall be the compilation of the minutes of each meeting.
source_title: UTD Policy UTDPP1009: Campus Housing Advisory Committee
section_heading: Membership: Chair, Vice Chair, and Recording Secretary

text: The Associate Vice President for Student Affairs shall serve as the Responsible University Official (RUO) for the Campus Housing Advisory Committee.
source_title: UTD Policy UTDPP1009: Campus Housing Advisory Committee
